name: Climbing Claw Mastery (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (climbing claws), Improved Unarmed Strike.

Benefit: You have mastered the use of the climbing claw, and have integrated it into your fighting style. You can climb an extra 10 ft in a round when using climbing claws, and the damage of your climbing claws increases by 1 die size.
